title: Liu et al. (2020): ZnO electron-transport nanoparticle dispersion
scopeLabel: Source-scoped direct PbSe inks, selenium-precursor preparation, conventional comparison route, PbS and ZnO adjuncts, device fabrication, and distinct characterization and cost-estimation contexts. general_background.title: From a metal precursor to reactive species
general_background.summary: A metal precursor supplies the metal, while its ligands and conversion chemistry influence how reactive species become available. Stronger or more persistent coordination can slow release of reactive metal species, while ligand exchange can open alternative conversion pathways.
